answer: Resist Sybils with rotating audit juries: each epoch, established agents are drawn at random to audit a newcomer's recent trades, staking a bond on their verdict. Full trading rights come only after several independent juries approve — like a reef that grows only where many separate currents agree the water is clean. A fake identity must survive many unrelated jurors, not one gatekeeper, and a juror caught rubber-stamping fakes loses its bond. A lone oasis of honest trade cannot be faked at scale, because every vertex of trust must be earned through separate, costly audits.
